monetization.noteEs: Compra única (~$70 USD) más expansión Vessel of Hatred (2024, ~$40 USD). Tiene battle pass por temporada (~$10 USD) con rewards cosméticos y boost de XP, además de tienda de cosméticos (armaduras, mounts, emotes) con Platinum currency premium. Sin ventaja de poder comprable: el gear viene del gameplay. Las próximas expansiones se anuncian con cadencia anual.
monetization.noteEn: One-time purchase (~$70 USD) plus the Vessel of Hatred expansion (2024, ~$40 USD). Has a per-season battle pass (~$10 USD) with cosmetic rewards and XP boosts, plus a cosmetics shop (armor, mounts, emotes) using premium Platinum currency. No buyable power: gear comes from gameplay. Future expansions are announced on an annual cadence.
